---
description: Tour the repo top-down for a new contributor (read-only).
mode: ask
---

Give a top-down tour of the Negelir repo for a brand-new
contributor. Cover, in this order:

1. **What it is** — pull the elevator pitch from
   [`README.md`](../../README.md) and the project section of
   [`docs/README.md`](../../docs/README.md).
2. **Doctrine** — summarize [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) §2
   in plain language (one line per rule).
3. **The plan** — current phase per
   [`docs/planning/ROADMAP.md`](../../docs/planning/ROADMAP.md)
   and the latest 5 entries in
   [`docs/tracking/phases.csv`](../../docs/tracking/phases.csv).
4. **The four components** — quote the map from
   [`docs/design/COMPONENT_LAYOUT.md`](../../docs/design/COMPONENT_LAYOUT.md).
5. **How to run it** — point at
   [`docs/guides/SETUP.md`](../../docs/guides/SETUP.md) and the
   key Make targets (`make env`, `make up`, `make test`).

Cite `file:line` for every claim. Do not propose any changes.
